projects.name: Dream Team
projects.summary: Seven specialised agents and an orchestrator that take a problem statement through domain rules, architecture, implementation, quality and scope review to reviewed, spec-backed code. Any agent runs on any provider (Claude, Codex or Ollama), and every agent's behaviour is schema-enforced and graded against an eval corpus.
projects.blurb: A team of specialised AI agents that takes a problem from domain rules to reviewed code, on any model provider, with every agent graded by evals.

projects.name: Kalman
projects.summary: A software factory: issues in, gated and reviewed PRs out, with a human in exactly the places a human belongs. A simple scheduler over an append-only event log; all intelligence in fresh, budgeted agent sessions; all authority in human-committed config. Kill anything, restart it, and it resumes from the log.
